headline_claim: ContextTrace emits an inspectable chain spanning support, citations, source condition, abstention, root cause, repair, and regression prevention.
audit_status: Supported as implemented behavior; clean and local tests pass.
cain_reuse_policy: Treat as prior system work if GroundLM is archival; CAIN novelty must be new empirical evidence.

headline_claim: The default path is deterministic, local, and requires no additional model calls.
audit_status: Supported for the default verifier path; optional judges and endpoints can make network calls.
cain_reuse_policy: Use with an explicit default-path scope; measure operational behavior anew for CAIN.

headline_claim: On 84 public-document Eval v2 cases, ContextTrace matches the frozen GPT-4.1-mini judge at 0.993 binary failure F1 and 0.012 dangerous false-green.
audit_status: Numerically traceable in local ignored artifacts; source cases and outputs are untracked; scenarios and labels are author-created.
cain_reuse_policy: Calibration/context only; cannot support CAIN independent generalization.

headline_claim: Eval v2 failure-label F1 is 0.457, root accuracy 0.583, citation F1 0.858, abstention F1 0.932, and unverifiable F1 0.000.
audit_status: Numerically traceable and honestly negative; underlying artifact is local and untracked.
cain_reuse_policy: Report only as prior calibration evidence and motivation.

headline_claim: A post-hoc replacement-relation rule removes Eval v2's sole false green.
audit_status: Traceable but explicitly result-informed and post-hoc.
cain_reuse_policy: Do not use as untouched evidence; classify as calibration.

headline_claim: A blinded 50-case annotation packet and scorer are released.
audit_status: Packet and scorer exist locally but are untracked; no completed independent human responses exist.
cain_reuse_policy: Infrastructure only; CAIN needs new sealed independent annotation.

audit_status: Supported; no independent response files were found.
cain_reuse_policy: Must remain explicit until new human evidence exists.

headline_claim: Groundedness-Truth-Gap has 180 cases with 1.000 failure F1, 0.944 source accuracy, 1.000 root accuracy, and 0.000 false-green.
audit_status: Traceable in local untracked author-curated artifacts; targeted fixes used this benchmark.
cain_reuse_policy: Prior conformance evidence only; not independent evaluation.

headline_claim: RAGTruth 200 has 0.955 failure F1, 0.955 root accuracy, and 0.000 false-green.
audit_status: Traceable with checksums; assisted review is pending independent sign-off; extensively used for v1 calibration.

headline_claim: The RAGTruth locked 120 subset has 0.945 failure F1, 0.942 root accuracy, and 0.000 false-green.
audit_status: Traceable locally; its results and errors have been inspected and published in manuscript tables.
cain_reuse_policy: Calibration control only; the word locked does not restore independence.

headline_claim: RAGAS has higher sparse claim F1 than ContextTrace on the locked RAGTruth subset (0.533 versus 0.367).
audit_status: Traceable and appropriately scoped to sparse labels; baseline output fields differ.

headline_claim: Lexical and MiniLM baselines score 0.957 binary F1 with zero false-green but predict failure on all 84 Eval v2 cases.
audit_status: Traceable; threshold selection is degenerate because dev contains no clean cases.
cain_reuse_policy: Do not present as a competitive CAIN baseline; redesign and preregister on separate development data.

headline_claim: The frozen GPT judge has 0.333 root accuracy, 0.346 citation F1, 0.364 abstention F1, and estimated cost of $0.035 on Eval v2.
audit_status: Traceable in local ignored artifacts; model and prompt are recorded.
cain_reuse_policy: Prior motivation only; rerun a pinned baseline on untouched CAIN IDs.

headline_claim: RAGAS and DeepEval naturalistic rows are N/A because no qualifying evaluator credential/model configuration was frozen.
cain_reuse_policy: CAIN needs a predeclared baseline plan and authorized access.

headline_claim: A 50-case LLM-simulated annotation audit agrees with author labels on 0.900 binary, 0.420 root, and 0.420 citation decisions, and misses all five positive unverifiable cases.
audit_status: Traceable; correctly labeled model-based and not human validation.
cain_reuse_policy: Protocol stress evidence only; never substitute for independent annotators.

headline_claim: On 90 constructed adversarial cases, a targeted change raises failure F1 from 0.873 to 0.934 and reduces false-green from 0.067 to 0.000.
audit_status: Traceable; cases are constructed and the change was tuned to observed errors.

headline_claim: A 14-case CRAG source-condition study found one clean authority conflict and two organic staleness pairs.
audit_status: Locally traceable but partly injected, tiny, and not a prevalence estimate.
cain_reuse_policy: Motivation only; CAIN needs a new natural source-condition track.

headline_claim: Failure blocking transfers more reliably than fine-grained attribution; the work does not establish broad superiority, truth verification, independent validation, or human actionability.
audit_status: Consistent with the reported negative and pending evidence.
cain_reuse_policy: Retain as prior-work limitation; CAIN claims depend entirely on new sealed evidence.
